item.title: Christopher Nolan's Mystery Thriller Masterpiece Is Officially Being Removed from Netflix
item.description: There are common elements that define a Christopher Nolan’s movie: the presence of Cillian Murphy , a Hans Zimmer score, and visual spectacle best seen on an IMAX screen. But the element that repeats itself the most is the director's obsession with time as both a storytelling device and filmmaking trick.

item.title: Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey Built a 36-Foot Cyclops Puppet and Hauled It Up a Mountain
item.description: The Odyssey ’s special effects supervisor Scott Fisher and visual effects supervisor Andrew Jackson spoke with Polygon about creating Polyphemus, the one-eyed giant who traps Odysseus and his men inside his cave before the Greek hero devises a plan to escape. As it turns out, the production's biggest obstacle ultimately led to one of its most effective creative decisions.

item.title: Sunrise on the Reaping Makes Hunger Games A Box Office Blockbuster Franchise Again
item.description: The opening weekend box office estimates for The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping are in, and it's off to a strong start. While The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes had a somewhat muted opening in 2023 compared to the franchise's original films, Sunrise on the Reaping has had the best opening weekend of any movie released this November.

item.title: GTA 6’s Worst Feature Needs to Be Patched ASAP
item.description: After years of waiting, Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here. And somehow, miraculously, it's living up to the impossible level of hype surrounding it. Rockstar's game is a staggering technological and artistic achievement in countless ways. The world of Leonida is vast and intricate, and the emergent gameplay enabled by hundreds of unique NPCs is truly astonishing . But there's one thing about GTA 6 I find absolutely infuriating so far, and it's extremely minor: depositing and withdrawing money from Jason's stash box and ATMs is a total pain in the ass.

item.title: All map fragment locations in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season
item.description: Fortnite 's Chapter 7 mini season , "Treasure Hunters," has added a new collectible to find throughout the season: map fragments . These map fragments will be added periodically during the season, and you'll get a special reward for finding them all.

item.title: Nintendo Officially Launches Black Friday Deals on Switch 2 and Games
item.description: Nintendo has officially launched its Black Friday deals for 2026, giving frugal holiday shoppers an opportunity to get a pair of Nintendo Switch 2 system bundles at a discount. Nintendo is also putting select digital and physical games for Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 on sale, with discounts on games such as Super Mario Party Jamboree and Metroid Prime 4: Beyond .

item.title: All sprites in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season
item.description: Sprites have taken over another season with their inclusion in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season, " Treasure Hunters ." These sprites work functionally the same way as they did in the last seasons: find them around the island, level them up, and extract them to master them. Mastering sprites will unlock different rewards, like sprite dust and cosmetics.

item.title: Where to find the Fast & Furious Mitsubishi Eclipse in GTA 6
item.description: In GTA 6 , Brian O'Conner's green Mitsubishi Eclipse from the first Fast & Furious movie can be yours if you know where to look. The car is a direct reference to the one we see Paul Walker's character driving early in the movie. It's a pretty fast car that can help you to quickly traverse the map and escape the police. Considering how good this car is, it's surprisingly easy to rob, making it a perfect special car to look for early in the game — as long as you have the funds to keep it for yourself .

item.title: GTA 6 Parody In Binding of Isaac Used AI Without Creator's Knowledge
item.description: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance Plus was recently at the center of gaming's latest generative AI controversy. Creator Edmund McMillen claimed music made with generative AI was used without his knowledge for a new daily run riffing on Grand Theft Auto 6 . Repentance Plus was released in full on Nov. 19 alongside its new console ports.

item.title: GTA 6 Could Actually Lose at Least 3 Game Awards Categories
item.description: After racking up an astonishing 99 rating on Metacritic — officially the highest ever — Grand Theft Auto 6 is more than the favorite to win Game of the Year at The Game Awards on Dec. 10. It's a certainty.
